account: It is day 1 at 06:00, and I have just woken at home. Today my recorded business is office hours at 08:00, a grain inspection at the east-bank mill at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, council letters in the office at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at the cottage at (16, -60, 105) at 15:00, office hours at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I should read the appointment book this morning to check for updates. Yesterday I asked the secretary to ask the mill about any concerns for the inspection; I have not yet heard a report. The neighbour mentioned rumours of a celebration or bridge changes, but had seen no evidence, and said the baker knew of no celebration. I do not know whether either rumour is true or what any changes would be for. I also saw a lantern appear in the town hall great hall yesterday, but did not see who placed it or learn why. Otherwise the news I heard was routine: fresh bread for market and the innkeeper tending supplies. The treasury held 128 emeralds when I checked yesterday and I left it untouched. Nothing I have directly observed establishes an unusual event today.
